actions.description: Check upstream file, seed service, and records db
actions.command: echo "=== upstream ==="; cat /var/lib/rollout/upstream; echo; echo "=== seed service ==="; cat /etc/systemd/system/rollout-seed.service 2>&1; echo "=== records schema ==="; sqlite3 /var/lib/rollout/records.sqlite3 ".schema" 2>&1; echo "=== records ==="; sqlite3 /var/lib/rollout/records.sqlite3 "SELECT * FROM records;" 2>&1

fi

actions.description: List rollout units and listening ports
actions.command: echo "=== all rollout units ==="; ls -la /etc/systemd/system/ | grep -i rollout; echo "=== is-enabled ==="; systemctl is-enabled rollout-v1.service rollout-v2.service rollout-proxy.service rollout-seed.service 2>&1; echo "=== listening ports ==="; ss -tlnp 2>/dev/null | grep -E '8080|8081|8082' || netstat -tlnp 2>/dev/null | grep -E '8080|8081|8082'
